newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian 1996/97 GDP growth seen at around 6.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indian 1996/97 GDP growth seen at around 6.0 pct.

text.p: ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) on Wednesday said it expected India's 1996/97 (April-March) GDP growth to be around 6.0 percent against the government's target of 7.0 percent.
"It would not be unreasonable to believe that we would end 1996/97 financial year with a real growth rate close to 6.0 percent than 7.0 percent as budgeted," it said in a report.
